title: 雨よけ豆ばたけ
concept: 雨で水が増え、晴れで減る三つの豆鉢。毎日一鉢だけを天候から守り、ちょうどよい水量を保つ。今日だけ得する鉢と明日の雨で困る鉢を見比べ、六日後にどれだけ収穫できるか、少し先の暮らしを考える栽培パズル。
howToPlay: 鉢を一つ選んで「一日進める」。選んだ鉢だけ水量が変わらない。水1〜2の状態で4回育つと収穫。
libraryDecision: 天候と水量の一段ずつの変化を読むことが核。Canvasで鉢・芽・雨よけを描き、物理や3Dによる連続変化は加えない。共有棚のライブラリは使わない。
soundDecision: 鉢の選択は短い音で返し、一日の終わりは育った鉢の数で音程を上げる。予報を考える間を急かさないためBGMは付けない。

candidates.idea: 雨と晴れの予報を見て一鉢だけ守る。水量がちょうどよい豆を六日間育てる。
candidates.ideaEn: Shelter one pot from forecast rain or sun and grow beans at balanced water levels over six days.

candidates.idea: ふたつの影が重なる瞬間にだけ開く門を抜ける散歩。
candidates.ideaEn: Walk through gates that open only when two shadows overlap.

candidates.idea: 坂に置いた鈴が一斉に鳴らないように道を描く音の仕掛け。
candidates.ideaEn: Draw paths on a slope so placed bells ring at different times.

en.title: Bean Weather
en.concept: Rain adds water and sun removes it from three bean pots. Shelter just one pot each day to keep water balanced. Compare today's growth with tomorrow's trouble, planning a little ahead to harvest as many pots as possible after six days.
en.howToPlay: Select one pot and advance a day. Only the selected pot avoids weather changes. Grow four times with water at 1–2 to ripen.
en.libraryDecision: Reading discrete weather and water changes is the core. Canvas draws pots, shoots and shelters directly; continuous physics or 3D would not strengthen the decisions. No shared library is used.
en.soundDecision: Brief tones acknowledge pot choices, and day-end pitch rises with the number of growing plants. No music rushes thinking about the forecast.

aiReview.comment: 9手の画像で鉢の選択、雨による増水、晴れによる乾燥、守った鉢の水量維持を確認。今日と明日の予報を見て六日間で3鉢を収穫し、再開も確認した。遅れた右の鉢を後半で追いつかせる判断はよかったが、育つ条件は全鉢共通で、天候は二つの並びだけなので遊びの奥行きは小さい。

similar.title: Planted
similar.note: 植物に必要な水などを各ラウンドに配分して育てる考え方が近い。本作は資源を集めるのではなく、天候による水量変化を一鉢だけ止める一人用の六日間。
similar.note_en: Both grow plants by managing needed resources over rounds. This six-day solo game does not collect resources; it prevents weather-driven water changes in just one pot.

similar.title: Plantabi: Little Garden
similar.note: 鉢植えを育てる穏やかな題材が共通。本作には庭の装飾や自由な配置はなく、天気を読む短い手番パズルが中心。
similar.note_en: Both share a calm potted-plant theme. This game has no garden decoration or free arrangement; it centers on a short turn-based weather puzzle.

aiReview.research: 栽培・水・日照について3件検索し、Plantedの作者公式ページとPlantabiの任天堂公式紹介を確認。水などの管理と鉢植えの題材を比較し、手番や操作の違いを記載した。

en.comment: Nine pictured steps confirmed selection, rain adding water, sun drying pots and shelter preserving water. Read forecasts to harvest all three pots over six days, then restarted. Helping the delayed right pot catch up was satisfying, but identical growth rules and just two weather sequences limit depth.
en.research: Ran three cultivation, water and sunlight searches. Checked Planted's designer page and Nintendo's Plantabi page, comparing resource care and potted-plant themes while noting differences in turns and interaction.

aiReview.method: スマホ縦画面で 9 手プレイ（時間を止めて1手ずつ操作）
aiReview.methodEn: Played 9 moves on a portrait phone screen (time frozen between moves)

playLog.note: 天候で水が増減し、一鉢だけ守る説明が読める。四回育てて収穫を目指す。
playLog.noteEn: The instructions explain weather changes, sheltering one pot and four growth days to ripen. Start planting.

playLog.note: 今日は雨、明日は晴れ。中央は水2なので、増やさず育てたい。中央を選ぶ。
playLog.noteEn: Rain today and sun tomorrow. Shelter the middle pot at water two so it can grow without getting wetter.

playLog.note: 中央に金の枠と傘が出た。選択が分かったので一日進める。
playLog.noteEn: A gold border and umbrella mark the middle pot. Advance the day.

playLog.note: 左と中央が1回育ち、右は水4で止まった。晴れが続くので左の水2を守り、ほかは乾かす。
playLog.noteEn: Left and middle grew once; the right is stuck at water four. With two sunny days ahead, shelter the left at two and let the others dry.

playLog.note: 左2・中央1・右3。中央を守れば左1・中央1・右2となり、三鉢とも育つはず。
playLog.noteEn: Water is two, one and three. Shelter the middle so all three reach water one or two and grow.

playLog.note: 三鉢とも育ち、左と中央はあと1回。雨で水2の右だけを守れば、全部がよい水量を保つ。
playLog.noteEn: All grew; left and middle need one more growth. Shelter the right at water two from rain so every pot stays balanced.

playLog.note: 左と中央が収穫できた。右は育ち2・水2なので、もう一度雨から守って育ち3へ進めたい。
playLog.noteEn: Left and middle ripened. The right is growth two at water two; shelter it from rain again to reach growth three.

playLog.note: 最後は晴れ。右の水2は1に減っても育つので、どの鉢も守らず一日進める。
playLog.noteEn: The last day is sunny. Water two on the right can fall to one and still grow, so advance without sheltering a pot.

playLog.note: 六日間で3鉢すべて収穫できた。次の畑が初期の水量へ戻るか再開する。
playLog.noteEn: All three pots ripened over six days. Restart to check the initial water levels return.

metrics.method: Codexのtoken_usage_recordをresponse_idで重複除去し企画開始から自己判定完了まで集計。入力はキャッシュ込み、出力から思考を控除。ツールはトップレベル呼出のみ。
metrics.methodEn: Aggregated unique Codex response usage from planning through review. Input includes cached tokens; output excludes reasoning; tools count top-level calls.
